gaps.title: Dark sidebar and frame around a light page
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: the white page (16px corners) sits in a #0a0a0a frame that is also the sidebar and the top bar. Sidebar rows #dcdcdc at 13/400; the current row a #242424 chip with a 1px #282828 edge and a #eeeeee 13/450 label; sub-rows #a6a6a6
gaps.standin: no inverse `shellTone`: a light sidebar with Origin's fill marker on the current row. `shellTone: recessed` + `navMarker: surface` reads like classic Polaris in light and holds the measure, but the dark current row falls to ΔL 0.015 against its rail (visual review, 2026-10-27)

gaps.title: Primary button sheen
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: #101010 pill primaries with a radial white sheen at the top and a glow at the bottom, an inner rim and a 4-layer soft drop; secondaries are flat #ebebeb pills with no shadow
gaps.standin: a flat charcoal primary (`buttonStyle: flat`): the finishes with a drop (gloss, rim-light) own the secondary and would drop the flat gray one

gaps.title: Button inline padding apart from height
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: 12px on 28px pills (primary, secondary, plain)

gaps.title: Tab height apart from density
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: pill tabs at button size: 28px, 12px padding, 12/500

gaps.title: Two control text sizes
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: buttons, tabs, badges and tooltips at 12px; field values, labels, menu rows, sidebar rows and body copy at 13px
gaps.standin: compact sets 12px on every control; `uiTextSize: 13` would move buttons and tabs with them

gaps.title: Body text size apart from controls
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: body copy 13px (ShopifyInter, -0.13px)

gaps.title: Sidebar nav row height apart from the control height
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: 30px rows at 13px (the current one 29px)

gaps.title: Heading scale
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: page titles 26px, section titles 22px, card titles 15px

gaps.title: Heading weight apart from the title style
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: every heading at 500, page titles included

gaps.title: Per-role letter spacing
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: -0.52px at 26px, -0.44px at 22px, -0.15px at 15px, -0.13px on 13px text, -0.12px on 12px buttons

gaps.title: Weights between the standard steps
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: the current sidebar row at 450 over 400 rows

gaps.title: Link weight
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: links in text 13/400 in ink, underlined; metric links on Analytics #0048e3, no underline

gaps.title: Select trigger apart from text fields
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: pickers with 8px corners and a 0.5px #8c8c8c edge beside text fields with 12px corners and a 1px #dedede edge
gaps.standin: `selectTrigger: field` draws the picker as a text field

gaps.title: Half-pixel hairlines
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: 0.5px #8c8c8c edges on pickers, switches and the checked radio (read at DPR 2)

gaps.title: Switch size apart from density
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: 32×16 track

gaps.title: Off switch track in its own tone, filled inside an outline or not
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: a white track inside a 0.5px #8c8c8c edge; on, #101010 with no edge

gaps.title: Checked radio edge
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: the checked radio keeps a 0.5px #090909 edge with an inner highlight and a 1px drop
gaps.standin: no edge on the filled radio

gaps.title: Overlay edge apart from cards
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: menus and tooltips draw a 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) ring (#ebebeb over white) under a 4-layer drop, while cards have no edge, only a 2px blur rim
gaps.standin: `surfaceEdge: none` drops the ring on menus too

gaps.title: Tooltip shadow
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: #101010 pill tooltips under the menus' 4-layer drop and 1px ring

gaps.title: Overlay corners apart from the rungs
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: popovers at 16px between 12px fields and 20px cards
gaps.standin: popovers on the card rung (19.5px at a 13px base)

gaps.title: Row, tab and segmented ink at rest
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: idle tabs #4a4a4a, between body and muted ink; sidebar rows #dcdcdc on black

gaps.title: Light-mode ink lightness

gaps.title: Field edges between the firm and strong lines
gaps.note: 2026 Admin: #dedede text-field edges (the firm line matches), #cccccc radio edges, #8c8c8c picker and switch edges

gaps.standin: `invalidStyle: edge` and `tint` turn the label red too (Polaris's `tint` matches the fill and edge by eye, not probed)

gaps.title: Neutral soft fills labelled in secondary ink
gaps.note: Classic Polaris (packages), not seen in the 2026 Admin yet: Polaris neutral badges, #616161 on 6% black (#f0f0f0 on white)
gaps.standin: ΔE 0.248 on Stripe's `soft-outline`, 0.251 on Polaris, 0.290 / 0.231 on Airbnb, 0.323 on Higgsfield, 0.513 / 0.463 on Duolingo, 0.195 / 0.145 on Claude); the neutral badge fill is #f8f9fa / #19191b (Polaris fill ΔE 0.012

gaps.title: Progress fill in the info color
gaps.note: Classic Polaris (packages), not seen in the 2026 Admin yet: #91d0ff (`bg-fill-info`) on #e3e3e3, while the brand stays #005bd3

gaps.title: Progress corners apart from the other tracks
gaps.note: Classic Polaris (packages), not seen in the 2026 Admin yet: Polaris rounds its 16px bar at 4px
gaps.standin: `tracks: round` rounds switch, slider and progress together (a pill: +4px on Polaris); `follow` squares or rounds the switch with them

gaps.title: Segmented control as joined buttons
gaps.note: Classic Polaris (packages), not seen in the 2026 Admin yet: each item a full secondary button (white fill, the bevel, 28px, 12px padding, 12/550 in full ink) butted against the next, square inner corners and 8px outer ones, no track; the pressed item on #cccccc under an inset shadow (`ButtonGroup variant="segmented"`)
gaps.standin: `segmentedTrack: outline` with `segmentedSelected: tone`: a 32px bordered track around clear 24–26px items, 9px item corners, a lighter chip (ΔE 0.045)

gaps.title: Calendar day numerals at their own size and weight
gaps.note: Classic Polaris (packages), not seen in the 2026 Admin yet: Polaris 12/450 (`bodySm`), today 700

gaps.title: Wide overlays
gaps.note: Classic Polaris (packages), not seen in the 2026 Admin yet: Polaris's Modal at 620px

gaps.title: Dark overlays kept on the card or page tone, set apart only by hairline and shadow
gaps.note: Polaris's `dark-experimental` goes the other way, a bigger lift: cards, menus, dialogs and tooltips on #303030 over the #1a1a1a page (low priority, Shopify ships no production dark mode)
gaps.standin: Polaris surfaces at 0.24–0.26 over the 0.21 page, ΔE 0.049–0.068

gaps.title: Tooltips that stay dark in dark mode
gaps.note: The 2026 Admin's tooltip is a #101010 pill in light; `dark-experimental` keeps it dark (#303030 under #e3e3e3)
gaps.standin: `tooltipStyle: inverted`, Origin's: the dark pill in light flips to a light chip in dark (ΔE 0.647)

gaps.title: Soft status fills in dark
gaps.note: No product value: Shopify ships no dark Admin, and `dark-experimental` (tokens 9.4.2) overrides none of the status colors. Coherence only: dark tints should stay as quiet as Origin's (oklch L 0.23, C 0.071)
gaps.standin: `vividness: 1.2`, set for the light status fills, also lifts dark tints to L 0.286–0.290, C 0.085–0.097 (accent, info, danger): the Logs warning banner and the Custom domain alert read as a brown slab under orange ink, the File manager's folder tiles navy and maroon (visual review, 2026-10-27)

gaps.title: Chart series from a cool multi-hue set
gaps.note: Polaris Viz (`@shopify/polaris-viz-core` 16.16.0, LIGHT_THEME): one series #13acf0; more series run #13acf0, #6a42e9, #597eed, #d147ac, #23baba, #9b3cdd, #9e84f2, #128ac0, #d75eb7, #305ee8, #af63e4, #33dbdb (blues, violets, magentas and teals, no status green, red or yellow); comparison series #0a97d5
gaps.standin: `chartPalette: mono`, tonal brand blues: the Banking donut's six slices blur together. `vivid` spreads hues around the brand and brings in status-like greens and reds (visual review, 2026-10-27)

gaps.title: Dark-mode ink lightness
gaps.note: Polaris #e3e3e3

gaps.title: Labels on brand solids in a set color
gaps.note: Polaris #fff labels on its #303030 charcoal primaries (`dark-experimental` flips it, #303030 on #fff)
gaps.standin: on Polaris the on-fill ink lands on the page tone, L 0.957 (ΔE 0.043)
